description: Use this when someone asks how renting or buying from MERA Robotics works: steps from inquiry to the robot on site anywhere in Europe, what the robot does at an event (including the role of event host), purchase and deployment, languages (more than 70 for robot conversations), pricing policy, what to include in an inquiry and what an inquiry does not do (it does not book a date or confirm a price).
